usedFor: Shopify raises store events like “Abandoned Checkout”, and Alltius receives a question for its assistant through “Chat”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Chat” in Alltius
bestTemplate.why: The assistant can draft a recovery message from the checkout details it is sent.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so “Chat” in Alltius runs after a scheduled check.
